name: MAESTRO: MIDI and Audio Edited for Synchronous TRacks and Organization
description: MAESTRO (MIDI and Audio Edited for Synchronous TRacks and Organization) is a virtuosic piano performance dataset developed by Google Magenta. It contains 1,276 performances (~198.7 hours) of classical piano music from 10 years of the International Piano-e-Competition, featuring paired, finely aligned CD-quality audio and MIDI recordings with sub-millisecond precision, providing a gold standard for automatic music transcription and expressive piano performance modeling.
